title: Schlicht: three quiet directions
question: Familiar, understated, well made. Pick one, or take the category standard.

options.label: Braun product sheet
options.lineage: Dieter Rams and Braun spec sheets, DIN typography, Ulm school
options.thesis: Weniger, aber besser. The engineer presented the way Braun presented a radio: precise, calm, one signal colour.
options.viewport: Large quiet name at left on a strict 12-column grid, a one-line positioning statement, a small portrait, and a spec table (Role, Focus, Location, Since 2011) set like a product data sheet.
options.risk: Close to the clean minimal portfolio. It only stands out through typesetting precision and the one orange indicator.

options.label: Tabellarischer Lebenslauf
options.lineage: the German tabular CV: years on the left, entries on the right
options.thesis: Your career as a perfectly typeset table. Hiring managers read it in ten seconds, and the rigour is the message.
options.viewport: Name and title at top, then a two-column table straight away: years | role, company, one line of impact. Projects and contributions follow in the same table grammar.
options.risk: Very plain. The quality has to come entirely from type, spacing and micro-motion.

options.label: Snapshot ledger
options.lineage: Iceberg table snapshots and time travel
options.thesis: A quiet one-column page where each career step is a committed snapshot, a subtle nod to data people.
options.viewport: Name and statement, then a vertical ledger of snapshots (2025 · Allianz Partners · snapshot 8f3a…) that rise in as you scroll.
options.risk: The data metaphor may read as a gimmick to non-engineers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern developer homepage at the level of leerob.com, rauchg.com or brittanychiang.com.
canonCard.viewport: Name, short bio, links, then project and writing lists.
canonCard.risk: Looks like those sites by design.
